text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you experience any numbness, tingling, or weakness in your limbs alongside the clumsiness? Have you noticed any changes in your vision, such as double vision or difficulty focusing, and do you have a history of high blood pressure or diabetes?

speaker: Doctor
text:
